answer: Require every agent identity to climb a small summit of verifiable work before it can act: each epoch it must present a fresh compute receipt, a benchmark solved with a unique nonce, that anyone can mirror-check against public parameters. Receipts decay, so an attacker cannot mint one opal of reputation and reuse it forever; each fake identity must keep paying real compute every epoch, while honest agents pay once and reuse their receipt within the window. Cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils, making large-scale fakery uneconomic.
